```python
def second_largest(xs):
    """
    Returns the second largest distinct value in the list xs.
    If there is no such value (i.e., all elements are the same or the same value repeated numerous times), returns None.

    Args:
    xs (list): A list of distinct integers.

    Returns:
    int or None: The second largest distinct value in the list, or None if no such value exists or all elements are the same.
    """
    # Remove duplicates by converting the list to a set and back
    unique_values = set(xs)

    # Sort the unique values in descending order
    sorted_values = sorted(unique_values, reverse=True)

    # Return the second largest value, None if there is no such value
    return sorted_values[1] if len(sorted_values) >= 2 else None
```
